limits.en: Unlimited reports and sharing; free tier is fully featured for individual reporting

keyLimits.en: Adds team collaboration, content management, and support on top of the free product

cautions.en: Looker Studio Pro pricing was not re-confirmed on the official pricing/help pages this session (redirect and 404 encountered); figure carried from prior seed data only.

capabilities.en: Free, no-code report and dashboard builder connecting to Google Analytics 4, Google Sheets, and BigQuery.
Shareable, embeddable dashboards with live data connections and community/partner connectors.

limitations.en: Advanced team management, asset organization, and support require the paid Pro tier.
Data freshness and connector reliability depend on third-party/community connectors, which are outside Google's direct support.

reason.en: Alternative BI/reporting tool covering similar dashboard and data-connection needs.

unknowns: Could not reach a live Looker Studio Pro pricing/help page this session (lookerstudio.google.com redirects to a dead datastudio.google.com URL); pricing not independently re-verified.
Exact free-tier limits (e.g. viewer/report caps) not detailed on the fetched homepage.
